predicates.question: Is append-only storage a requirement for the proposed audit store?
Does the approved design provide a mechanism for per-account event ordering?
Must this future-system research provide deployed runtime proof?

material_gap_candidates.description: The future audit store has no deployed telemetry.
The future design lacks a per-account ordering mechanism.

planner_obligations.description: Plan the proposed audit store as future-system work.
Do not require deployed proof for behavior that does not exist yet.
Preserve append-only behavior and per-account ordering in implementation and verification steps.
